A headerless table whose rows have different cell counts is padded, not turned into a list

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr><tr><td>C</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
